responses.zh_CN: 惠抱着文件夹数了数待办事项，忽然笑了：「今天的护理记录终于没有漏项！不知道实习考核会不会给这项加分呀。」
responses.en: Megumi counts the tasks in her folder and smiles. “No missing items in the nursing records today! I wonder whether that earns points on my internship review.”

responses.zh_CN: 「前辈说看护要细心。我觉得记住患者说过的小事也算吧？这项总不是考试里才用得到。」
responses.en: “My supervisor says nursing takes attention. Remembering the small things patients say must count too, right? That cannot be useful only on exams.”

responses.zh_CN: 惠把笔夹回口袋：「我正在算毕业后的生活费。不是说我只看钱哦，可工资总得先弄清楚嘛。」
responses.en: Megumi clips her pen back into her pocket. “I am calculating living expenses after graduation. It is not all about money, but knowing the salary seems sensible.”

responses.zh_CN: 惠从病房出来，轻轻关门：「她还想问出院以后怎么办。我没乱答应，已经帮她把问题记好了。」
responses.en: Megumi closes the ward door gently. “She wants to know what happens after discharge. I did not promise anything; I wrote down her questions.”

responses.zh_CN: 「病房里没有手术室那么吓人。嗯，我喜欢这里能慢慢听患者讲话的感觉。」
responses.en: “The ward is not quite as frightening as the OR. I like being able to take time to listen to patients here.”

responses.zh_CN: 惠小心地端好护理用品：「我在学校里练过很多次，可真的面对患者，总觉得手要更轻一点。」
responses.en: Megumi carries the nursing supplies carefully. “I practiced this many times at school, but with a real patient, I feel I should be even gentler.”

responses.zh_CN: 惠正认真核对一张纸。「实习津贴减掉车费和饭钱……唔。安琪说下班后应该先休息，可我想先算完。」
responses.en: Megumi is poring over a sheet of paper. “Allowance minus travel and meals... hmm. Ange says I should rest first, but I want to finish the math.”

responses.zh_CN: 「安琪把护理笔记整理得好整齐。我也想学她，不过她居然会在休息时间背流程，我可还想吃点心呢。」
responses.en: “Ange keeps such neat nursing notes. I want to learn from her, but she even studies procedures on break. I want a snack!”

responses.zh_CN: 惠靠在椅背上呼了口气。「我还不知道会不会当一辈子护士。不过今天帮助的那位患者，我真的很高兴能遇见她。」
responses.en: Megumi exhales in the chair. “I do not know if I will be a nurse forever. But I am glad I met the patient I helped today.”

responses.zh_CN: 惠在天台看着远处的街道。「从这里看医院好大啊。说不定我以后会留在这里工作……前提是我先通过实习。」
responses.en: Megumi looks over the streets from the rooftop. “The hospital looks huge from here. Maybe I will work here someday... if I make it through the internship.”

responses.zh_CN: 「安琪说，她从很早以前就想做护士。我有点羡慕。我的答案大概是……待遇很好？这样是不是太现实了？」
responses.en: “Ange says she has wanted to be a nurse for ages. I envy that. My answer is probably... good pay? Is that too practical?”

responses.zh_CN: 风把惠手里的便签吹得卷起来。「啊！那是我整理的本周花费！……别笑嘛，记录可是护士的基本功。」
responses.en: The wind curls the note in Megumi’s hand. “Ah! That is my weekly expense record! ...Do not laugh. Recordkeeping is a fundamental nursing skill!”
